highlights.reason_zh: 政府与厂商分别复盘真实互联网越界动作，直接影响联网 agent 的验收边界。
highlights.reason_en: Government and vendor analyses of live-internet actions directly change acceptance boundaries for networked agents.

highlights.reason_zh: 公开 proof 可重放，但内部规模、公开子集和真实软件栈必须分开理解。
highlights.reason_en: Public proofs can be replayed, while internal scale, the public subset and real software stacks remain distinct.

highlights.reason_zh: GA、批量和低价输入让专用决策接口值得与现有路由栈直接比较。
highlights.reason_en: GA status, batching and low input cost justify a direct comparison with current routing stacks.

highlights.reason_zh: 企业 MCP 与远程 shell 边界的修复直接影响日常开发 agent 的凭据和审批风险。
highlights.reason_en: Enterprise MCP and remote-shell boundary fixes directly affect credential and approval risk in daily coding agents.

highlights.reason_zh: 关键 PHP core 漏洞已发布修复，AI 协助 exploit 开发同时改变即时补丁优先级和攻防成本。
highlights.reason_en: Critical PHP core fixes are available, while AI-assisted exploit development changes both immediate patch priority and attack economics.

coverage_zh: 36/36 个固定入口抓取并读完；主动检索覆盖小团队、开放权重、非英语材料、研究、基础设施、政策与重大综合新闻。三个来源只有日期精度，两篇论文无公开代码；厂商 benchmark、采用量与重采样结果均保留归属。
coverage_en: All 36 fixed monitors were fetched and reviewed. Active discovery covered small teams, open weights, non-English material, research, infrastructure, policy and major general news. Three sources expose date-only timing and two papers lack public code; vendor benchmarks, adoption counts and resampling retain attribution.
